blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fewer passengers were recorded at ports across the country during this year’s Undas holidays compared to the same period last year due to higher fares and shorter vacation days, according to the Philippine Ports Authority (PPA). The PPA reported that a total of 1,362,454 passengers passed through ports managed by the agency from Oct. 27 to Nov. 2. This was fewer than the 1,623,836 passengers recorded during the same period last year.
